```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(20)){
  si<-i^2
  print(si)
}
for (i in seq_len(5)){
str<-paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse="")
print(str)
}
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
menu<-tibble()
for (i in seq_len(10)){
  new_row<- tibble(
    food_item = sample(breakfast, 1),
    food_amount = sample(1:5,1)
  )
  menu <- menu|>bind_rows(new_row)
}
gt(menu)
```
